requirements_summary: Workload: chat-based support assistant (latency-sensitive) + embeddings for in-product search. Targets: p50 < 100ms EU for chat; p95 < 300ms under 200 rps sustained. Throughput: initial 50-200 req/s, scale to 500 rps over 12 months. Data residency: all logs, KV caching metadata, and customer PII must remain in EU. Key management in customer-controlled KMS (bring-your-own-key preferred). SSO via SAML; audit logs retained 90-365 days per retention policy. Routing: prefer EU primary, multi-region read-fallback for DR only. Cost sensitivity: medium-high — will trade some latency for cost but expect Redwood Optimize recommendations for batching/quantization. POC asks: compare Hosted vs Dedicated p95, cost per 1M tokens, and implications of multi-region routing on cache hit rates.
decision_criteria: 1) Meets EU data residency & KMS controls; 2) Predictable p95 under Dedicated sizing; 3) Transparent pricing for multi-region failover; 4) Integration work minimal (SAML + S3/KMS); 5) Support SLA and runbook for DR
poc_plan: Phase 1: 4-week Hosted pilot (baseline metrics, synthetic load, real traffic spikes) — collect p50/p95, token cost, cache hit rate. Phase 2: 4-week Dedicated POC in eu-central-1 (reserved capacity) with same workload, measure delta in latency and unit cost. Phase 3: small multi-region config: EU primary + US fallback for non-PII traffic; test routing policies and measure cross-region latency penalty. Deliverables: metrics deck, cost TCO, recommended deployment plan. Timeline: kickoff week of 2026-03-10 if budget cleared.
